findings.highlight: And she is shot from the side by numerous bright bullets.
findings.evidenceJa: 横合いから放たれた、無数の光弾の前に弾かれていた。
findings.governingReading: Countless light projectiles fired from the side knock Rider’s stake away before it reaches Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the impact to Rider herself instead of the stake, changing the rescue choreography and target.
